# Paper 20: DiT (2023)

*Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers* · Module 8 — Modern generative modeling · [Track on the site](https://arubad.github.io/AI_Research_Journey/#paper-20)

## Study approach
#5 ViT + #9 DDPM. Patchify latents into tokens; adaLN-Zero injects t and class c by predicting $(\gamma, \beta, \alpha)$ with the final linear layer zero-initialized so each block starts as identity. More GFLOPs → lower FID.

## Break-it experiments
1. **HAND** — One DiT block with the conditioning MLP; zero-init its final linear vs Xavier and watch early convergence speed (the ResNet zero-γ trick again).
   - Code: `experiments/exp1_one_dit_block_with_the_condition.ipynb`
2. **AGENT** — The full latent-diffusion training scaffold.
   - Code: `experiments/exp2_the_full_latent_diffusion_traini.ipynb`
